stage: Platform Core Baseline: Development -> Operation. Introduced Workspace (Student+School+Semester[]) as the platform's single top-level Context — real Login flow (login.html, fixed 3-step: Student -> School -> Semester, permission-filtered, multi-select supported), real per-Workspace Learning State isolation (js/core/PersistenceAdapter.js namespaces every save/load/remove under the active Workspace's storage namespace — zero code change in any of the 16 sessionStorage-backed Runtimes; falls back to the exact legacy unprefixed key when no Workspace is active, so every pre-Sprint-AI-119 test keeps passing unmodified), Topbar Current Workspace display + quick-switch (no re-Login), logout scoped to clear only the Workspace pointer (not a full wipe — a deliberate, disclosed change from Sprint AI-113 AI-805's original behavior). Repository gained school/semester metadata classification (docs/TeachingMaterials/schema/Metadata.schema.json, all 4 real materials migrated to 長榮中學/高一下學期 per §9, no ID/content change) — flagged as metadata-only, NOT a physical directory restructure (regression-risk judgment call, see Architecture doc). New tests/regression/WorkspaceRegression.js (36 checks) + playwright/tests/workspace.spec.js (4 real-browser cross-navigation Student-isolation tests, the actual §20 PAT scenarios, stable across 3 repeated runs). Every pre-existing suite kept 100% green via a shared test-harness fix (auto-seeded default test Workspace in each suite's own single loadPage()/page-fixture, idempotent bare-key namespacing) rather than rewriting ~500 individual test bodies. All suites PASS: npm run verify PASS, npm test 330/6/29/37/35/42/36 all PASS, Playwright 25/25 PASS, QA Dashboard Overall PASS. Disclosed open items: Material Center's own filtering UI doesn't yet read the new school/semester Repository fields (metadata-only today); no physical directory move. See docs/EO/SPRINT_AI119_Platform_Core_Baseline_Report.md and docs/Architecture/Architecture_Workspace_Baseline_v1.0.md.
